parameters.name: City
parameters.description: The city. The default value is Hangzhou.

parameters.name: CommonName
parameters.description: The common name of the certificate.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: The country. The default value is CN.

parameters.name: Organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization. The default value is Alibaba Inc.

parameters.name: OrganizationUnit
parameters.description: The name of the department. The default value is Aliyun CDN.

parameters.name: SANs
parameters.description: The Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate. These are the domain names that are bound to the certificate. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple domain names.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The province or state. The default value is Zhejiang.
